topic: Dashboard metric name changes deployed to production
summary_markdown: The team reviewed several items, including dashboard metrics explanation and joint controller agreement signing. [p1] proposed minor naming convention updates for two key metrics: 'Total Traffic Screens' was changed to 'Total Traffic Cluster', and 'Total Traffic Footfall' was changed to 'Total Traffic'. These changes were confirmed as safe because the underlying data remained consistent. [me] subsequently deployed these name changes to the Production environment, confirming completion.
decisions: The names for two dashboard metrics ('Total Traffic Screens' and 'Total Traffic Footfall') will be updated to 'Total Traffic Cluster' and 'Total Traffic', respectively.
action_items: [me] pushed the metric name changes to the Production environment.
